premise.property: Each nonzero residue has exactly one ordered difference to-from among the supplied difference-set residues; translated lines give the accepted projective plane.

input.operation: Insert the missing edge from point 0 to line 0 and keep it. Classify smallest sets of original edges whose removal restores C4-freeness.

result.scope: Every old C4 is absent by the identified premise; each possible new C4 is hit by one selected original edge.

retained_reader.scope: Fresh reader over saved new-cycle and base-coefficient records. Conditional coefficient tables and cost/edge arithmetic are new query work, fully retained.

original_input.property: Each nonzero residue has exactly one ordered difference to-from among the supplied difference-set residues; translated lines give the accepted projective plane.

formal_statement.read_scope: Complete decoded statement; both research-open annotations and local placeholders retained, no proof audit.

source_premises.graph_conventions: Furedi–Simonovits arXiv:1306.5167v2, ordinary simple subgraphs, bipartite point-line types.
source_premises.construction_credit: Classical Singer plane; trace-zero cyclic difference-set account in Meszaros–Ronyai–Szabo arXiv:1908.05591, consumed through accepted #31474.

validation_scope: Source inspected and syntax-parsed, frozen and banked before one constructor call. Complete actual construction and fresh saved-reader outputs banked in their producing calls. Loader is structural, not a recertification of the accepted plane or a proof checker for arbitrary forged tables.
boundary: Keep the inserted edge. Delete original edges only. The result classifies the minimum repairs for this one input; weighted queries minimize within that family. No global extremal, rational-exponent, novelty or prize claim.
